row:
Pamper Your Pup with a Massage

Dog massage therapist = my dream job! Being a dog massage therapist is my dream job! It is not only a profession to me, but it is also my calling. I have committed myself to a lifetime of improving the quality of life of dogs. I have mastered every manual technique for their unique anatomy so I can improve their wellbeing.
I could not imagine myself doing anything else because nothing is closer to my heart than my furry friends and working with them gives me the greatest pleasure. The moment I saw the happiness of my first canine client I knew this was my path. I believe it is important not to take dogs out of their everyday environment, so I do in-home massages. I can perform dog massage therapy anywhere requested, but the smell of home and familiar surroundings is key in helping your dog achieve relaxation. This way, there are no distractions, and we can focus on complete unwinding and healing during the session.
